author: Spoookeh
body:
Hey guys, Spookz here.

So recently I just thought, I've only changed my name once. So yeah, I want to spread the boat really.
Firstly I would like to keep the theme of Spooks, because that's how everyone recognises me.
I would like to add another word, something cool like fusion, radioactive etc..
Also, I wouldn't mind any Latin seen as I'm still studying it in school.

Thanks and list as many names as you can!
